content: दाक्षायण {%a.%} (-णी|{%f.%}) Coming from the Dakṣa family. .{@-णः@} .²1 A son of Dakṣa. .²2 A particular sacrifice. .{@-णम्@} Gold or a golden ornament.

दाक्षायणी [दक्षस्यापत्यं स्त्री इञि फक्-ङीप्] .²1 Any one of the 27 lunar mansions (they being mythologically regarded as so many daughters of Dakṣa). .²2 <ab>N.</ab> of Diti, wife of Kaśyapa and mother of the demons. <ls>Bhāg. 8. 4. 22</ls>. .²3 <ab>N.</ab> of Pārvatī. .²4 The lunar constellation called Revatī. .²5 <ab>N.</ab> of Kadru or Vinatā. .²6 <ab>N.</ab> of Aditi, mother of the gods. .²7 The Dantī plant.
